viewing_check: Check the head inside and out for hairlines or cracks (hold to light, look at rim and ears), eye and wig-pad condition, whether the body is original Handwerck (marked 10 on torso is odd for a size 3 1/2 head, check it matches), and whether all limbs and spare parts are present.
